data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure and step order (EDGAR search, 10-K filter, Wikipedia infobox, drafted email), but it hardcodes the recipient as dana@example.com instead of using {manager}@example.com, omits the latest 10-K period, and ends with an ambiguous "Discard or send" instead of always discarding, so an automation would be mostly buildable but the recipient would be wrong for other managers and sending is risky.
